RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Assigning a percentage would imply knowledge we don’t have.

Your PhD and eight years of section leadership are substantial qualifications, but they don’t establish that you were strongest against the full selection criteria. Her relevant experience may extend beyond the announcement.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, your assessment against them, and the reasons the successful candidate was preferred.

If you uncover sex-based remarks, inconsistent criteria, or departures from recruitment procedures, raise those specific concerns. If you suspect discrimination, check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not stop them.
